items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton reveals Ferrari F1 car damage after Las Vegas Q2 exit
items.summaryEn: Both Ferraris failed to make it out of Q2 in qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, with Lewis Hamilton attributing the exit to energy deployment and floor damage.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿揭示法拉利F1赛车在拉斯维加斯排位赛Q2出局后的损伤
法拉利两位车手在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中表现不佳，均未能晋级Q3
汉密尔顿将法拉利在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中的Q2出局归因于能量部署和底板损伤，这位七届世界冠军觉得自己已经从整体轮胎抓地力的困难中恢复过来。
这位英国车手在第三节练习中刹车时全程挣扎，前轮特别容易锁死，导致汉密尔顿多次冲出赛道进入缓冲区。
汉密尔顿在排位赛首节虽然底板受损，但仍闯入了Q2，不过他和夏尔·勒克莱尔都未能进入争夺杆位的前十名淘汰赛。
汉密尔顿在Q2的飞驰圈中总体显得满意，这些圈速很少出现他在排位赛前常见的锁死轮胎现象，但法拉利动力单元的能量部署似乎比梅赛德斯和红牛动力赛车更早达到极限，抑制了直线性能。
法拉利在动力上一直落后于这两家制造商，而拉斯维加斯大道沿线的长加速区在整个练习与排位赛节次中暴露了这一劣势。
“我们在Q1的第一圈或第二圈损失了一块底板，赛车平衡发生了变化，我想我们损失了大约三到四成的下压力，”汉密尔顿表示。
“而在那之后，我们更多是在打滑方面挣扎，但基本上从一开始就是这样。”
“然后我的最后一圈在结尾时真的很好，但我用现有的条件做到了最好。但后来我们仅仅在部署上就损失了大约零点六秒。所以我认为有了那个我们本可以进入Q3，但除此之外我对自己的圈速感到满意。”
“我们知道长直道之类的东西会很有挑战性。差距在直线上似乎比我预想的要大一点。这并非微不足道。在直道上是一个很大的部分。”
一直有一种普遍的感觉，认为法拉利会在拉斯维加斯的低温条件下挣扎，因为该车队在整个2026赛季都难以在排位圈中保持轮胎温度。
汉密尔顿也认为这辆赛车很难驾驭，在低速弯中频繁打滑，尤其是在损失了一部分底板之后，他只希望法拉利能在周六晚上的正赛中有所进步，因为车队的目标是锁定制造商年度亚军。
“就抓地力而言，感觉我们并没有很强的抓地力。我们一直很难让轮胎进入工作状态，就是有点找不到感觉，”他补充道。
“今年这些轮胎非常非常难进入工作状态，即使在高温路面上也是如此。所以这确实很困难。我对正赛没有任何期待。只是想看看自己能不能往前赶。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton reveals Ferrari F1 car damage after Las Vegas Q2 exit
Both Ferraris failed to make the cut for Q3 after floundering in qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix

Lewis Hamilton put Ferrari's Q2 exit in qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix down to energy deployment and floor damage, as the seven-time champion felt he'd rallied from difficulties with overall tyre grip.
The Briton struggled throughout FP3 under braking, as the front tyres proved particularly lock-up prone and resulted in Hamilton enduring multiple excursions into the run-off.
Hamilton landed in Q2 despite suffering floor damage in the opening stage of qualifying, but neither he nor Charles Leclerc were able to make their way into the top-10 shootout for pole.

Hamilton appeared generally happy with his runs in Q2, which demonstrated few of the lock-ups characteristic of his lead-up to qualifying, but the Ferrari power unit's energy deployment seemed to hit its maximum sooner than the Mercedes and Red Bull-powered cars and inhibited straightline performance.
Ferrari has been down on power versus those two manufacturers, and the long acceleration zone along the Strip exposed this deficit throughout the session.
"We lost a piece of the floor on the first or second lap of Q1 and the car balance shifted, and we lost I think it was like three or four tenths of downforce we lost," Hamilton stated.
"And then after that we were struggling more so with sliding, but it was basically from the get-go.

"And then my last lap was really good at the end, but I did the best I could with what I had. But then we lost something like six tenths just on deployment. So I think with that we would have been in Q3, but otherwise I was happy with my lap.
"We knew long straights and stuff was going to be challenging. The gap seems to be a little bit more than I anticipated in a straight line. It's not insignificant. It's a big chunk on the straights.

There had been a pervading sense that Ferrari would struggle in the low-temperature conditions in Las Vegas, as the team has struggled throughout 2026 to maintain tyre temperature through a qualifying lap.

Hamilton agreed that the car was difficult to work with amid frequent sliding through the low-speed corners, especially after losing a chunk of floor, and only hopes that Ferrari can move forward in the Saturday night race as it aims to lock out second in the constructors' championship.
"Just grip-wise, it just didn't feel like we had a ton of grip. We were struggling to get the tyres working and we were just kind of nowhere," he added.

"These tyres have been very, very difficult this year to get working, even on hot surfaces. So it's definitely been difficult. I don't have any expectations [for the race]. Just trying to see if I can move forward."

“极度沮丧”的汉密尔顿透露了赛车损伤和能量部署问题
汉密尔顿在整个练习阶段都缺乏速度，他表示这是由于他在早期阶段对自己的赛车造成了损伤。
“我很沮丧，”汉密尔顿告诉天空体育F1频道。“我们努力做好工作。
“我其实不太清楚我们今天会处在什么位置。我们知道在这些长直道上我们会有些吃力，但我进入时是乐观的，我以为赛车会没问题。
“但在第一圈或第二圈，我们的底板被什么东西撞了一下，一些碎片或其他东西损坏了底板，我们因此损失了大量下压力，大约零点几秒。

与勒克莱尔不同，汉密尔顿在Q2末尾成功完成了一个飞驰圈，但他表示，一个能量部署问题几乎断送了他晋级的机会。
“然后我倾尽了全力，”他补充道。“我那圈在最后已经做到了最好，但我前面没有车，接着我们在最后阶段出现了能量部署不足，光在部署上我就损失了大约0.6秒。
“祸不单行。今天就是这样的日子。
“我们当时拼尽全力只想进入第三节排位赛。我认为如果没有部署损失，没有下压力损失，我本可以进入第三节排位赛，但那仍然会很艰难。”
“但事已至此，已经结束了。对整个车队来说这绝对不是什么好受的感觉，但我们明天会努力向前看。”
勒克莱尔对法拉利在正赛中的前景感到沮丧，正赛将于周日凌晨4点在天空体育F1频道直播，他坚称车队缺乏直线速度会让他很难向前推进。
当被问及反击的可能性时，他说：“我不这么认为，因为我们在直道上损失了一秒，所以 literally 我们没有任何地方能够超车。”
安东内利在排位赛中跑出最快圈速，但马克斯·维斯塔潘将从头名发车，因为梅赛德斯为安东内利更换了本赛季第六台内燃机，他将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上接受五位发车位罚退。
天空体育F1评论员杰米·查德威克表示，她能理解两位车手为何会对车队在排位赛中的执行感到沮丧。
查德威克说：“我不理解的一点是，我认为这正是查尔斯所指的执行问题，他在最后一圈没有任何犯错余地。这让他很沮丧。
“而在刘易斯这边，他始终是孤军奋战。如果他们说在直道上损失了一秒，那至少应该设法创造有利条件，利用尾流给自己最好的机会。”

detailEn: Las Vegas GP: Lewis Hamilton 'devastated' and Charles Leclerc 'angry' after both Ferrari drivers make shock early exits from qualifying

Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were both eliminated from Q2 during qualifying in Las Vegas; Leclerc will start the race from 10th, with Hamilton a place behind him; watch Sunday's race at 4am (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
Both Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc were eliminated from Q2 as Ferrari were left frustrated in Las Vegas qualifying
Charles Leclerc was left "angry" while Lewis Hamilton said he was "devastated" after both Ferrari drivers suffered shock early exits from Las Vegas Grand Prix Qualifying.

The Italian team had arrived at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit wary of the challenges the long straights and cold temperatures could pose them, but Friday night's session went far worse than either driver had anticipated.
Both drivers were eliminated in Q2 as Leclerc took 11th with Hamilton a place behind him. They will each move a position forward on the grid due to a penalty for McLaren's Oscar Piastri.

Leclerc appeared to have more than enough pace to reach Q3 but made a mistake on his final flying lap. The Monegasque was infuriated by Ferrari not having left him enough time to go for another lap in the event of an error or issue.
"Yes, for sure (Q3 was on the cards) but we didn't do a good job," Leclerc told Sky Sports F1.
"I did a mistake the only lap I was given, basically.

"And at the same time, the execution has been very poor. I don't know. We'll review.
"I'm very angry now, so I would rather not speak too much. But I think there were plenty of things we could have done much better."
'Devastated' Hamilton reveals damage and deployment issues
Hamilton was lacking pace throughout the session, which he suggested was caused by damage he had done to his car in the early stages.
"I'm devastated," Hamilton told Sky Sports F1. "We work hard to do a good job.
"I didn't really know where we were going to be today. We knew we would struggle a little bit with these long straights, but I was optimistic going in, I thought the car would be OK.
"But on the first or second lap, we took a hit from something on the floor, some debris or something damaged the floor and we lost a bunch of downforce with it, a few tenths."
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton was left frustrated after he could only qualify 12th for the Las Vegas Grand Prix
Unlike Leclerc, Hamilton was able to get a flying lap in at the end of Q2, but he said a deployment issue all but ended his hopes of advancing.

"And then I was giving it everything," he added. "My lap was as good as it could be at the end, but I didn't have anyone ahead of me, and then we had a lack of deployment at the end and I lost like six tenths just on deployment.
"When it rains it pours. It was just one of those days.
"We were scrapping to just get into Q3. I think without the deployment loss, without the downforce loss, I think I could have got into Q3, but it would have still been tough.
"But it is what is, it's over. It's definitely not a nice feeling for all the team, but we'll try to move forwards tomorrow."

Leclerc was downcast over Ferrari's prospects for the race, which is live on Sky Sports F1 at 4am on Sunday morning, insisting their lack of straight-line speed would make it difficult for him to move forward.
Asked about the prospect of a fightback, he said: "I don't think so because we are losing a second down the straights, so there is literally nowhere we will be able to overtake."

Chadwick said: "The thing that I don't understand, and I think this is where Charles refers to the execution, he had no margin to make a mistake on that last lap. That's frustrating for him.

"And then on Lewis' side, he was always on his own. If they're saying that they're losing a second on the straight, at least stack the odds in your favour to have a slipstream and give yourself the best chance."

这位红牛车手表示，最后一轮飞驰时对手车队比他更聪明，但他认为从第四位发车让他“处于争夺领奖台的有利位置”。

伊萨克·哈贾尔承认，在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛末段的尾流争夺中，红牛“显得有点蠢”。他表示周六晚上的发车位置“并不太重要”。
哈贾尔在Q3做出第五快成绩，落后基米·安东内利0.699秒，而队友马克斯·维斯塔潘在意大利人接受五位发车格罚退后夺得杆位。哈贾尔在发车格上升至第四位。
Q3的最后几轮飞驰圈变成了一场猫鼠游戏，车手们试图在拉斯维加斯赛道漫长的直道上跟住其他车手以获取尾流。虽然许多人都做到了，但哈贾尔只能依靠自己的福特动力单元。
“不，我们没有尾流。所以是的，最后一轮我们在外面看起来有点蠢，但其他车队玩得非常聪明，我们在出维修区时他们把车停在1号弯，”哈贾尔说。
前方无人，哈贾尔表示，由于直道上没有尾流，一个好圈速无论如何都无法实现，所以他决定放弃。
当被问及红牛下次是否会更好地玩这些策略游戏时，他承认自己更愿意纯粹地比赛，而不是依赖这种情景的赌博。
“是啊，反正我不太喜欢那些游戏。我喜欢把车开快，”他说。“有些事你确实控制不了，这有点像掷骰子。”
“是啊，所以我不太在意。只要我知道自己在弯道里很快，我就对此感到高兴。最终，我们明天从第四位发车，所以我们对领奖台处于有利位置。”
哈贾尔相信自己有速度在前方竞争，他说“我绝对在那里”。
“我这边的工作已经完成，而且我认为这是一条凭借这些超长直道和现行规则很容易超车的赛道。所以第四、第五、第二，最终其实都无所谓，我很开心，”他说。
哈贾尔在红牛的首个赛季已三次登上领奖台，分别在摩纳哥、阿塞拜疆和圣保罗，其中在圣保罗他排在兰多·诺里斯和维斯塔潘之后获得第三。
红牛会欢迎再添一个领奖台，车队正在争夺车队锦标赛第二名，目前仅领先迈凯伦17分，而赛季只剩三场比赛。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar: Red Bull "looked a bit stupid" in Vegas qualifying tow game
The Red Bull driver says rival teams outsmarted him on the final run, but he believes starting fourth leaves him "in a good position for a podium"
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Isack Hadjar has admitted that Red Bull "looked a bit stupid" in what became a tow battle at the end of Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying. He says it "doesn't really matter" where he starts on Saturday night.
Hadjar set the fifth-fastest time in Q3, 0.699s behind Kimi Antonelli, while team-mate Max Verstappen took pole after the Italian's five-place grid penalty. Hadjar moves up to fourth on the grid.

The final runs in Q3 turned into a game of cat and mouse, as drivers attempted to position themselves in the tow of other drivers down the long straights of the Vegas circuit. While many achieved, Hadjar was left to rely on only his Ford power unit.
"No, we had no tow. So yeah, we looked a bit stupid out there for the final run, but the other teams played it very smart, parking the car in Turn 1 while we were exiting the pit," Hadjar said.
With nobody ahead of him, Hadjar said a good lap would have unraveled regardless with no tow on the straights, so he decided to abort.
Asked whether Red Bull would play those games better next time, he admitted he'd rather just race and not rely on the gamble of such a scenario.
"Yeah, I don't really like those games anyway. I like driving the car fast," he said. "There's just things you can't really control, and it's a bit like rolling the dice."
"Yeah, so I don't really care. As long as I know I was quick around the corners, I'm happy about that. And in the end, we're starting fourth tomorrow, so we're in a good position for a podium."
Hadjar was confident he had the pace to fight at the front, saying "I am definitely up there".

"Job done on my side, and then I think it's a track where you can easily overtake with these massive straights and with the current regulations. So P4, P5, P2, it doesn't really matter in the end, so I'm happy," he said.
Hadjar has three podiums in his first season with Red Bull, at Monaco, Azerbaijan and Sao Paulo, where he finished third behind Lando Norris and Verstappen.
Another would be welcome for Red Bull, which is fighting for second in the constructors' championship and just 17 points ahead of McLaren, with just three races to go.

detailZh: 拉塞尔：拉斯维加斯排位赛尾流"太难协调"
拉塞尔排位赛位列第三，但安东内利的罚退使他升至第二位，与马克斯·维斯塔潘同排发车
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯F1车手乔治·拉塞尔在错失杆位后表示，在拉斯维加斯排位赛中要获得完美的尾流"太难协调"。
拉塞尔在Q3中跑出第三快的时间，落后队友基米·安东内利0.331秒，落后红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘0.073秒。由于安东内利因动力单元更换被罚退五位，他将与维斯塔潘并排从第二位发车。
在拉斯维加斯大道的高速直道上，尾流效应价值巨大。考虑到安东内利已被处以引擎罚单并在墨西哥赢得了车手总冠军，拉塞尔在排位赛最后一圈前一直在询问能否从队友那里获得尾流牵引。
但当所有人涌出维修区时，最终受益于尾流的却是这位意大利车手，而非拉塞尔。
当天空体育询问梅赛德斯的计划是否奏效时，拉塞尔表示：“这太难协调了，要获得完美的尾流风险极高。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“基米，如果他晚一秒开始飞驰圈，根本跑不完一圈，而最终他在直道上赚回了一秒，甚至更多，可能在弯道里丢了六成。所以这简直难以置信。
“整体影响而言，我对这节练习仍然非常满意，因为今天每一圈或整个周末，我都相当有竞争力。”
谈到最后一轮飞驰圈混乱的开局，这位英国车手补充道：“两次在队首离开维修区时我都非常紧张。但当有些车手做预热圈、另一些车手直接冲刺时，这太难协调了。每个人都在找尾流。”
“现在有点墨西哥对峙的意味。所以最终来说，这是高风险、高回报。明天从第一排发车，我们已经连续三场比赛都处在第一排了。所以这还不错。”
2026赛季还剩三站，拉塞尔目前位列车手积分榜第三，落后第二名维斯塔潘17分，仅领先第四名法拉利车手汉密尔顿1分。
detailEn: George Russell: Las Vegas qualifying tow was "too difficult to orchestrate"
George Russell qualified third, but Kimi Antonelli's penalty promotes him to second alongside Max Verstappen
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes Formula 1 driver George Russell claimed that getting the perfect tow in Las Vegas qualifying was "too difficult to orchestrate" after he missed out on pole position.

Russell set the third-fastest time in Q3, 0.331 seconds behind team-mate Kimi Antonelli and 0.073s off Red Bull's Max Verstappen. He will start second, alongside Verstappen, after Antonelli's five-place grid penalty for power unit changes.

A slipstream is worth a huge amount on the long straights of the Las Vegas Strip. Taking into account that Antonelli has been handed an engine penalty and won the drivers' championship in Mexico, Russell had been asking about getting a tow from his team-mate on his final run in qualifying.
But as everyone piled out of the pits, the Italian driver ended up being the one to benefit from a tow rather than Russell.
Asked by Sky Sports whether Mercedes' plans had worked, Russell said: "It was so difficult to orchestrate and getting the perfect tow is high risk.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
"Kimi, if he started his lap a second later, wouldn't have gone a lap in and in the end, he gained a second on the straight, maybe more and maybe lost six tenths in the corners. So it's unbelievable.
"The impact overall, I'm still very pleased with the session because every lap today or this whole weekend, I've been pretty competitive."

Addressing the chaotic start to the final flying laps, the Briton added: "I was very nervous when I left the pits on both occasions at the front of the pack. But it's too difficult to orchestrate when you've got some drivers doing a prep lap, other drivers going straight for it. Everyone's going for a tow.
"There's a bit of a Mexican standoff. So in the end, it's high-risk, high-reward. And starting on the front row tomorrow, three races in a row we've been on the front row. So that's all right."

With three rounds remaining in the 2026 season, Russell currently sits third in the drivers' championship, 17 points behind Verstappen in second and just one point ahead of Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in fourth.

items.originalTitle: George Russell slams Max Verstappen after Las Vegas clash: ‘He walks around like he’s bigger and better than everyone’
items.summaryEn: George Russell and Max Verstappen collided in Free Practice 3 at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, and Russell publicly criticised Verstappen afterwards.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯碰撞后猛烈抨击马克斯·维斯塔潘：“他走路的样子好像自己比所有人都更大、更好。”
在第三节自由练习中发生该事件后，拉塞尔对维斯塔潘极为不满。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯。
乔治·拉塞尔在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节自由练习中与马克斯·维斯塔潘发生碰撞后，对后者进行了抨击。
维斯塔潘在第14号弯前超越了前方的梅赛德斯赛车，以求获得干净空气，但拉塞尔随即反超，荷兰人试图关门未果。拉塞尔最终强行将对手挤开，红牛车手随后向他竖了中指。
拉塞尔对维斯塔潘的驾驶方式感到愤怒，这也让后者收到了赛会的警告。“我认为警告是合理的，但你知道……规则里并没有说不能超越正在开始飞驰圈的人，但当你这么做时，你就是在坑害这个人，”这位英国车手对意大利天空体育表示。
“他每周都和许多车手这样干，大家都接受了，但我不会接受有人这样坑我，还装作自己比所有人都高人一等。总得有人站出来对抗那家伙。”
与此同时，维斯塔潘在排位赛后的新闻发布会上对情况的评价很直接：“什么都没发生。”
警告基本上无关紧要，因为与训诫不同，如果再次犯规，警告不会导致更重的处罚。
尽管如此，维斯塔潘仍被认定对这起事件负有责任，以下是干事们的看法。
干事报告写道：“两辆车都在接近14号弯，3号车在63号车前方。3号车比预期更早刹车，并在刹车时改变方向。从后方接近的63号车向左移动，试图从内线超车。在这一操作过程中，63号车的前轴位于3号车后视镜的前方。随后两车发生了接触。”
“在听证会上，车手们还讨论了关于飞驰圈准备的非正式君子协定，以及在这种情况下车手之间应有的行为。干事们注意到了这些解释，但认为此类非正式谅解对事件评估的相关性有限。决定性的考量是两辆车的实际动作及其相对位置。
“因此，干事们审查了3号车的刹车和变向、63号车的避让动作和位置，并考虑了适用的驾驶标准指南。
“干事们认为，3号车在刹车下变向是不可预测的，并导致了63号车不得不向内移动以避免接触的情况。虽然干事们认为该动作不够严重，不足以给予更严厉的处罚，但他们得出结论，在这些情况下刹车下变向低于预期的驾驶标准。
“考虑到事件的情况，干事们确定车手警告是适当的。”
维斯塔潘和拉塞尔将在周六的拉斯维加斯大奖赛中共享头排，他们分别以第二和第三名排位，而最快圈速的安东内利则被罚退五位发车。
detailEn: George Russell slams Max Verstappen after Las Vegas clash: ‘He walks around like he’s bigger and better than everyone’
Russell was highly frustrated with Verstappen following the incident that occurred in FP3
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
George Russell has hit out at Max Verstappen after they collided in Free Practice 3 at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Verstappen overtook the Mercedes ahead of Turn 14 in a quest for free air, but Russell moved to get back ahead, with the Dutchman unsuccessfully closing the door. Russell eventually muscled his rival out of the way, with the Red Bull racer later giving him the middle finger.

Russell was indignant at Verstappen’s driving, which earned him a warning from the stewards. “I think a warning was fine but, you know... There's nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting the lap, but when you do this, you are screwing this person over,” the Briton told Sky Sport Italy.

“He does this week in week out with many drivers and everybody accepts it, and I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else. Somebody's got to stand up to that guy.”
Meanwhile, Verstappen’s assessment of the situation in the post-qualifying press conference was straightforward: “Nothing happened.”
A warning is largely inconsequential as, unlike a reprimand, it cannot lead to a bigger penalty in the event of a repeat offence.
Still, Verstappen was found responsible for the incident, and here is how the stewards viewed it.

“Both cars were approaching Turn 14, with Car 3 ahead of Car 63,” the stewards’ report read. “Car 3 braked earlier than expected and changed direction under braking. Car 63, approaching from behind, moved to the left and attempted to overtake on the inside. During the manoeuvre, the front axle of Car 63 was ahead of the mirror of Car 3. The two cars subsequently made contact.

“During the hearing, the drivers also discussed the informal gentlemen’s agreements concerning the preparation for a flying lap and the conduct expected between drivers in such situations. The Stewards noted these explanations but considered that such informal understandings were of limited relevance to the assessment of the incident. The decisive considerations were the actual movements of both cars and their relative positions.
“The Stewards therefore examined the braking and change of direction of Car 3, the evasive manoeuvre and positioning of Car 63 and taking into account the applicable Driving Standards Guidelines.

“The Stewards considered that Car 3’s change of direction under braking was unpredictable and contributed to the situation in which Car 63 had to move to the inside to avoid contact. While the Stewards did not consider the manoeuvre sufficiently serious to warrant a more severe penalty, they concluded that changing direction under braking in these circumstances fell below the standard of driving expected.
“Taking into account the circumstances of the incident, the Stewards determined that a Driver Warning was appropriate.”
Verstappen and Russell will share the front row in Saturday’s Las Vegas GP, having qualified respectively second and third with pacesetter Kimi Antonelli taking a five-place grid penalty.

拉塞尔最终将维斯塔潘挤开，维斯塔潘随后向其竖中指。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen overtook Russell's Mercedes ahead of Turn 14 to seek clean air, Russell then tried to retake the position and Verstappen's attempt to close the door failed.
Russell eventually muscled his rival out of the way, and the Red Bull driver later gave him the middle finger.

items.originalTitle: Russell won't accept being 'screwed over' by Verstappen
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛练习中指责马克斯·维斯塔潘在赛道上表现得“盛气凌人”。
在FP3练习中，拉塞尔和维斯塔潘在14号弯发生碰撞，裁判对维斯塔潘发出警告，原因是他在刹车中移动。
在排位赛中，尽管维斯塔潘因基米·安东内利的引擎处罚而获得杆位，但两人都对事件表示不满，并将在正赛中从第一弯开始对决。
拉塞尔表示，他不接受被这样对待，并认为维斯塔潘经常以这种方式对待许多车手。
“我认为警告是恰当的。规则中没有规定你不能超越正在开始一圈的车手，但当你这么做的时候，你就是在坑这个人，而且他每周都这样对很多车手做，而每个人都接受了这一点，”拉塞尔告诉天空体育意大利。”
“我不会接受有人这样坑我，然后像他们比所有人都大或更好一样四处走动。”
“所以，是的，有人必须站出来对抗那个人。”
拉塞尔和维斯塔潘有历史，因为拉塞尔声称维斯塔潘在2024年卡塔尔大奖赛之前，因为维斯塔潘因为阻挡拉塞尔而被罚退后，曾说过要把他‘他妈的’撞到墙上。”
两位车手在显然寒冷的排位赛前三名赛后新闻发布会上被问及最新的FP3事故，基米·安东内利将他们区分开来。
当被问及此事时，维斯塔潘简单地回答道：“没有发生什么。”，而罗素说：“没有混淆，我认为很清楚。”
国际汽联在拉斯维加斯周末宣布，从2027年开始，一级方程式将首次使用全职专业裁判员。
罗素称这一举措为“太棒了”，并表示“一级方程式可能是唯一一个只有志愿者裁判或裁判员的高水平运动……有很多裁判员在他们的工作中做得很好，但如果没有一致性，每个人都会略微不同地解释情况。
“如果你每周都有同样的三周和四周，我们都会知道他们在想什么。我很高兴听到这已经实现了。”
detailEn: George Russell has accused Max Verstappen of “walking around like they’re bigger and better than everyone else” after they clashed in practice at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Russell and Verstappen banged wheels at Turn 14 during FP3 with the stewards issuing Verstappen with a warning for moving under braking.

Neither was impressed and both were clearly still frustrated with the incident after a qualifying session that ensured they’ll share the front row together in Las Vegas, with Verstappen moving up to pole thanks to Kimi Antonelli's engine penalty.
With Russell second, the duo will likely face off into Turn 1 in the grand prix proper.

“I think a warning was fine. There's nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap, but when you do this, you are screwing this person over, and he does this week in, week out with many drivers, and everybody accepts it,” Russell told Sky Italia.
“I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this, and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else.
“So, yeah, somebody's got to stand up to that guy.”

Russell and Verstappen have history as Russell claimed Verstappen said he was going to “put me on my f***ing head in the wall" before the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix after Verstappen lost pole position to a grid penalty for impeding Russell.
Both drivers were asked about the latest incident in FP3 in a clearly frosty post-qualifying top-three press conference, with Kimi Antonelli dividing them.
“Nothing happened” Verstappen simply said when asked about it, while Russell said “no confusion, it was pretty clear I think”.
The FIA announced earlier in the Vegas weekend that F1 would use full-time professional stewards for the first time from 2027.

Russell called that move “fantastic”, saying “Formula 1 was probably the only high-level sport that would have volunteer referees or stewards…there's a lot of stewards that are great at what they do but when there isn't the consistency everybody interprets a situation very slightly differently.
“If you have the same three same four week in week out we'll all know what what they're thinking. I'm very glad to hear that's come to fruition.”
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘因在刹车中移动而被处以警告。
两人对事件均表示不满，并在排位赛中占据前两位。
keyPointsEn: Max Verstappen received a warning for moving under braking.
Both drivers were unhappy with the incident and ended up on the front row of the grid.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯练习赛冲突后向马克斯·维斯塔潘发起挑战
乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯第三节练习的冲突后猛烈批评马克斯·维斯塔潘，称“总得有人站出来对抗那家伙”。
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘本已化解前嫌的任何希望，在周五晚上的14号弯烟消云散。在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习中与这位红牛车手发生车轮碰撞数小时后，拉塞尔在排位赛后发表了尖锐批评——而两人恰好锁定了周六晚上正赛的头排发车位。
第三次练习赛临近结束时，维斯塔潘在超越拉塞尔后，于14号弯前减速以准备飞驰圈，冲突由此爆发。拉塞尔拒绝让出赛道位置，从内线切回，而维斯塔潘在刹车时移动，两人发生轮对轮接触。维斯塔潘在车队无线电中抱怨拉塞尔“把我逼向护栏”，并竖起中指，而拉塞尔则打趣道：“好玩吧，嗯？”
排位赛后，拉塞尔明确表示，他的不满远不止一次练习赛中的某个弯角。
“规则里没有任何一条说不能超越正在开始飞驰圈的人，但你这是在坑害这个人，”拉塞尔说。“他每周都和许多车手这样干，所有人都接受了。”
“我不会就这么接受有人这样坑害我，还到处走来走去，好像他们比所有人都更大更强，”他补充道。“总得有人站出来对抗那家伙。”
在混乱的第三次练习赛中，拉塞尔并非唯一被维斯塔潘激怒的车手。兰多·诺里斯在车队无线电中庆祝“现世报”，此前维斯塔潘强行超越后立刻锁死冲入12号弯的缓冲区；与此同时，赛会干事还调查了维斯塔潘在引擎部署问题期间于阿尔派车手弗兰科·科拉平托前方变线一事，并最终未予追究。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
关于与拉塞尔的冲突，赛会干事指出两位车手都提到了关于飞驰圈准备的“非正式君子协定”，但认为这些协定“相关性有限”。干事认定维斯塔潘刹车比预期更早，并在刹车下改变方向——低于“预期驾驶标准”——因此对其发出车手警告。
这让维斯塔潘免于三周前墨西哥城那样更严厉的处罚，当时他和利亚姆·劳森都因第二次练习赛的冲突被罚退后一位发车，并各扣一个罚分。
F1最动荡对决的又一章
这一警告在排位赛中得到了应验。尽管新加冕的世界冠军基米·安东内利跑出了最快圈速（1分33秒893），但他因罚退五位，将杆位拱手让给了维斯塔潘（1分34秒151）——仅领先拉塞尔（1分34秒224）0.073秒。
两人的头排搭档重现了F1最激烈的宿怨之一，从2024年卡塔尔站干事室的风波——当时拉塞尔指责维斯塔潘感觉自己“凌驾于规则之上”——一直延续到2025年西班牙大奖赛的碰撞。周五早些时候，1997年世界冠军雅克·维伦纽夫在天空体育F1节目中警告说，拉塞尔承担了“不必要的风险”，并补充道：“你不想与马克斯为敌。”维斯塔潘在积分榜上以279分对262分领先拉塞尔17分，位列第二，显然拉塞尔并没有听进去。
detailEn: George Russell challenges Max Verstappen following Las Vegas practice clash
George Russell blasts Max Verstappen after their Las Vegas FP3 clash, saying "somebody's got to stand up to that guy"
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Any hope that George Russell and Max Verstappen had buried the hatchet evaporated at Turn 14 on Friday night. Hours after banging wheels with the Red Bull driver in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, Russell unleashed a blistering post-qualifying critique - just as the pair locked out the front row for Saturday night’s race.

The flashpoint came late in FP3 when Verstappen passed Russell before slowing ahead of Turn 14 to prepare his lap. Refusing to concede track position, Russell dived back down the inside, only for Verstappen to move under braking as the two made wheel-to-wheel contact. Verstappen complained over team radio that Russell had "pushed me into the barrier" and flashed his middle finger, while Russell quipped, "Fun and games, eh?"
Speaking after qualifying, Russell made clear his frustration went far beyond one practice corner.

"There's nothing in the rules that says you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap, but you're screwing this person over," Russell said. "He does this week in and week out with many drivers and everybody accepts it."
"I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else," he added. "Somebody's got to stand up to that guy."

Russell was not the only driver irritated by Verstappen during a chaotic FP3. Lando Norris celebrated "instant karma" on team radio after Verstappen forced his way past and immediately locked up into the Turn 12 run-off, while stewards also investigated - and cleared - Verstappen for weaving in front of Alpine’s Franco Colapinto amid an engine deployment issue.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

For the Russell clash, stewards noted both drivers referenced "informal gentlemen's agreements" on lap preparation, but deemed those of "limited relevance". Concluding that Verstappen braked earlier than expected and changed direction under braking - falling "below the standard of driving expected" - they issued a driver warning.
That spared Verstappen the harsher fate of Mexico City three weeks ago, when he and Liam Lawson both received one-place grid penalties and a penalty point for an FP2 run-in.
Another chapter in F1’s most volatile rivalry

The warning proved decisive in qualifying. Although newly crowned World Champion Kimi Antonelli set the fastest time (1m33.893s), his five-place penalty elevated Verstappen (1m34.151s) to pole - just 0.073 seconds ahead of Russell (1m34.224s).

Their front-row pairing revives one of Formula 1’s fiercest feuds, stretching from their 2024 Qatar stewards’ room fallout - when Russell accused Verstappen of feeling "above the law" - to their 2025 Spanish Grand Prix collision. Earlier on Friday, 1997 World Champion Jacques Villeneuve warned on Sky F1 that Russell took an "unnecessary risk", adding, "You don't want to make an enemy of Max." With Verstappen leading Russell by 17 points for second in the standings (279 to 262), Russell clearly isn't listening.

detailZh: 勒克莱尔拉斯维加斯排位出局后难掩挫败，法拉利赛车劣势尽显
这位法拉利车手表示，在Q2出局之前，车队的一系列失误已让挫败感不断累积，赛车在拉斯维加斯大道赛段整整损失了一秒。
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更远地方的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
勒克莱尔确认，法拉利在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中“在直道上损失了一秒”，而车队此前的一系列失误以及Q2出局让他的挫败感不断累积。
勒克莱尔排位赛位列第11，距离Q3晋级线仅差0.111秒，比表现挣扎的刘易斯·汉密尔顿高出一个名次。这是法拉利自去年伊莫拉站以来首次双车止步Q2。
这位摩纳哥车手在7号弯锁死轮胎冲出赛道后放弃了该圈，随后未能及时赶到终点线开始最后一次冲击更快圈速的尝试。
“是的，总的来说我非常失望，”他在霓虹灯下对记者说道。“当然，Q2的那个失误让我们付出了代价，但我认为这是积累了大量挫败感的结果，我们在整体管理、交通状况和其他事情上犯了很多错误。”
“这毫无帮助，尤其是在这样一条一切都取决于轮胎的赛道上。你必须把轮胎带入正确的工作窗口。我更多是在看后视镜，试图自己判断交通状况，这让做任何事情都变得非常困难。”
法拉利的直线速度再次遭到其车手的批评，赛车在赛道长直道上难以与强劲的对手抗衡。
“我觉得我们在直道上损失了一秒。不是我觉得，是我们在直道上损失了一秒，这太疯狂了，”他说。
“在这样的赛道上，这是本赛季对动力最敏感的赛道，所以我们预料到会很艰难。但我原本以为能进第三节排位赛（Q3）。”
与周五晚上的其他几支车队不同，两辆法拉利未能互相利用尾流（tow）帮助，但真正造成差距的是赛车无法保持轮胎温度。“我们知道这是我们的弱点，”勒克莱尔说。
他说：“我不知道其他人是否面临和我们一样的问题，但当你遇到那个问题时，要等两辆车并把握好时机是非常困难的，因为那要求你开得比你能达到的速度更慢。”
除此之外，法拉利向他传达信息的情况也不理想，这位车手提到早上“GPS出了很多问题”。
他说：“如果是GPS问题，那不一定来自我们这边，那就是我们无能为力的事情，今天很痛苦。如果问题来自我们这边，我确实同意我们需要审视它并显然要改进。特别是在这样的关键时刻，我们需要到位，而我们没有。”
汉密尔顿有自己的问题，他将自己的出局归咎于底板损伤和能量部署不足。
在发车格罚退生效后，两辆法拉利各上升一位，勒克莱尔将从第10位起步，汉密尔顿从第11位起步。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc frustrated after qualifying exposes huge Ferrari deficit in Vegas
The Ferrari driver says frustration had been building over the team's mistakes before his Q2 exit, and that the car lost a full second on the Strip
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Charles Leclerc has confirmed that Ferrari "lost one second down the straight" during qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix as his frustration builds following a build-up of mistakes from the team and a Q2 exit.
Leclerc qualified 11th, just 0.111 seconds off the Q3 cut-off and one place ahead of a struggling Lewis Hamilton. It was Ferrari's first double Q2 exit since Imola last year.
The Monegasque aborted a lap after locking up at Turn 7 and running off the track, then failed to make it to the line in time to start one last attempt at a faster time.

"Yeah, I mean, I'm very disappointed as a whole," he told journalists under the neon lights. "Of course, there's the mistake in Q2 that we paid the price of, but I think that is following a lot of frustration building up with a lot of mistakes with the way we managed everything, traffic and other things.

"That doesn't help, particularly on a track like this where it's all about tyres. You've got to put tyres in the right window. I was more looking in my mirrors and trying to understand the traffic myself, that it makes it very difficult to do anything."
Ferrari's straight-line speed also once again received backlash from its driver, with the car struggling to put up a fight against its potent rivals down the circuit's long straight.
"I think we lost a second down the straight. Not I think, we lost one second down the straight, which is crazy," he said.
"On a track like this, it's the most power-sensitive track of the season, so we expected to have a hard time. But I was expecting to go through Q3 though."

Unlike several other teams on the Friday night, the two Ferraris failed to help each other with a tow, but it was the cars' unwillingness to keep heat in their tyres that made the difference. "We know it's our weakness," Leclerc said.

"I don't know if the others are facing the same issues as we do, but when you have that problem, then it's very difficult to wait for the two cars and to kind of time it well, because that requires you to go slower than what you can," he said.
On top of this, Ferrari's communication of information to him had not been ideal, with the driver citing "a lot of problems on GPS" in the morning.

"If it's a GPS issue, which doesn't necessarily come from us, then it's something that we cannot do much, and today was painful," he said. "If it comes from us, I do agree we need to look at it and obviously improve. Particularly in the critical moments like this, we need to be there, and we didn't."
Hamilton had his own problems, blaming floor damage and a lack of deployment for his exit.
Both Ferraris move up a place once grid penalties are applied, with Leclerc starting 10th and Hamilton 11th.

安东内利在Q3中创造了最快圈速，但由于更换引擎被处以五位发车网格的罚分，这意味着马克斯·维斯塔潘将占据杆位发车，拉塞尔紧随其后，排在第二位，他在比赛中创造了第三快的圈速。
这位意大利车手在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军，但拉塞尔仍在为第二名而战。这位28岁的车手目前在积分榜上排名第三，落后第二名维斯塔潘17分，领先第四名法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿一分。
梅赛德斯车队老板托托·沃尔夫在排位赛后表示，拉塞尔在最后一圈的位置“完美无缺”，他落后前车四秒，并表示车队需要找出哪里出了问题。

“车队没有做任何事情来帮助拉塞尔。当他说他落后四秒时，他处于一个很好的位置。这是他自己的努力。车队没有帮助他，”维伦纽夫在天空体育F1上解释道。

“基米特意确保自己不会领先于拉塞尔，以确保他不会帮助他的队友。这是显而易见的，”他说。
“他玩了自己的游戏，尽管他知道最终无法获得杆位。所以这有点卑鄙。”
三次W系列赛冠军和天空体育评论员Jamie Chadwick，他与维伦纽夫一起参与直播，认为Brackley车队在最后一圈的顺序是错误的，说"乔治在最后一圈本应该排在基米后面"。
detailEn: Jacques Villeneuve: Mercedes 'did nothing' to help George Russell in Las Vegas qualifying
The 1997 world champion says Mercedes did nothing to help George Russell in Las Vegas qualifying
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve says Kimi Antonelli was "a little bit nasty" for refusing to give George Russell a tow in Las Vegas qualifying, and claims Mercedes did nothing to help the Briton.

Antonelli set the fastest time in Q3, but a five-place grid penalty for an engine change means Max Verstappen will start on pole, with Russell alongside him in second after setting the third-fastest time.

The Italian driver secured the drivers' title at the Mexican Grand Prix, but Russell is still in the fight for second. The 28-year-old currently sits third in the standings, 17 points behind Verstappen in second and one point ahead of Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in fourth.

Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said after qualifying that Russell "had the perfect position" for his final lap, running four seconds behind the car in front, and that the team needed to find out what had gone wrong.
Villeneuve did not agree with that version of events.

"The team didn't do anything to help Russell. When he said he was four seconds behind, he was in a good position. That was from his doing. The team did not help him," Villeneuve explained on Sky Sports F1.
Villeneuve said Wolff had "kind of skirted the answer", before turning on Antonelli, who has already wrapped up the 2026 title.
"Kimi went out of his way to make sure he wasn't ahead of Russell, to make sure he wouldn't help his team-mate. And that was obvious," he said.
"He played his own game, even though he knew that he couldn't get pole in the end. So that was a little bit nasty."

Three-time W Series champion and Sky Sports pundit Jamie Chadwick, who joined Villeneuve on the broadcast, agreed that the Brackley outfit had the order wrong, saying "George always should have been behind Kimi in that last run".

这位红牛车手将在周六晚上的正赛中从第一位发车，拉塞尔排在第二，尽管两人在排位赛中都不是最快，安东内利驾驶另一辆梅赛德斯赛车以0.258秒的优势拿下最快圈速。
但更换了新的内燃机意味着他需要接受五位发车格罚退，正因如此，他在第三节排位赛中的角色最初是帮助拉塞尔，为队友提供尾流牵引。
在低风阻的拉斯维加斯街道赛道上，交通状况常常是个问题，所有梅赛德斯、阿尔派和小红牛赛车在最后一轮冲刺前挤在一起就是明证。
两位车手都不想先出发，安东内利最终选择放弃，这意味着拉塞尔没有得到这位意大利车手的尾流牵引，但沃尔夫仍然不认为这能解释他为何没能拿下杆位。
“乔治，在我看来，占据了完美的位置，”沃尔夫对天空体育说。“他落后前车四秒。
“我们需要查明原因，因为我认为在七号、八号、九号弯附近出现了某种……不管是失误还是发生了其他情况。
“说实话我不知道，但那看起来像是做出杆位圈的理想位置，因为他全程都是最快的。”
梅赛德斯车队的安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔
拉塞尔跟在小红牛青训车手阿维德·林德布拉德身后，比自己的首个Q3圈速快了两成，跑出1分34秒224，而安东内利只是勉强及时冲过终点线。
这让这位2026年世界冠军从暂列第六跃升至第一，而当被要求解释安东内利如何跑出最快圈时，一脸困惑的沃尔夫表示“完全不知道”。
“作为策略师，当时我们认为基米的这一圈要么赶不上，要么会与林德布拉德非常接近，结果他冲线时落后1.4秒，基本就是这样。
“所以我不理解，在那么接近的情况下，怎么可能跑出这个时间。”
但这为维斯塔潘和拉塞尔之间一场引人入胜的对决埋下伏笔，两人在第三节练习赛中发生冲突，该节练习赛由这位英国车手领跑，他同时也是第一节排位赛的最快车手。
“嗯，真是大戏一场，”沃尔夫说。“如果他们试图一起通过前几个弯角，我们可要好好看着了。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff: George Russell was in the "perfect position" for pole at F1's Las Vegas GP
The Mercedes driver lost out to team-mate Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen in Nevada
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
Mercedes boss Toto Wolff believes George Russell was in the “perfect position” to take pole at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix - an honour which ultimately fell to Max Verstappen.
The Red Bull driver will start Saturday night’s race from first with Russell second, despite neither going fastest in qualifying as Kimi Antonelli was quickest by 0.258s in the sister Mercedes.
But a new internal combustion engine means he has a five-place grid drop and because of that, his role in Q3 was to initially help Russell by giving his team-mate a tow.
Traffic is often a problem at the low-downforce Vegas street track, however, evidenced by all Mercedes, Alpine and Racing Bulls cars being grouped together ahead of the final run.
Neither driver wanted to go first and Antonelli ultimately backed out, meaning Russell received no tow from the Italian, but Wolff still doesn’t think that’s an explanation for him not taking pole.
“George, for me, had the perfect position,” Wolff told Sky Sports. “He was four seconds behind the car in front.
“We need to find out, because I think there was some kind of... turn seven, eight, nine, some, whether that was a mistake or something else happened.
“I don't know, to be honest, but it looked like the ideal position for a pole lap because he was quickest all the time.”
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
Russell followed Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad, beating his first Q3 lap by two tenths to set a 1m34.224s, while Antonelli only just crossed the finish line in time.
It allowed the 2026 world champion to go from provisional sixth to first and a confused Wolff had “absolutely no clue” when asked to explain how Antonelli went fastest.
“As a strategist, when we thought Kimi's either gonna miss the lap or it's gonna be way too close to Lindblad, and crossed the line 1.4 seconds behind, and that was basically it.
“So I don't understand how being that close you can even do this time.”
But it sets up a fascinating match-up between Verstappen and Russell, who clashed in FP3, a session topped by the Briton who was also fastest in Q1.
“Well, big cinema,” said Wolff. “If they try to go through the first corners together, we shall be watching.”

detailZh: 汉密尔顿称底板损伤影响拉斯维加斯排位赛
这位法拉利车手表示，碎片造成的损伤和能量部署不足导致他无缘Q3，两辆法拉利均在Q2被淘汰。
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更远地方的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析和比赛反应。
七届F1世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，底板损伤和能量部署不足导致他在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中无缘Q3。
这位法拉利车手排位赛位列第12名，距离进入前十仅差0.167秒，比队友夏尔·勒克莱尔落后一位。这是法拉利自去年伊莫拉站以来首次双车止步Q2。
汉密尔顿目前正在争夺车手锦标赛第二名，他告诉天空体育F1，尽管马拉内罗车队预计在拉斯维加斯的长直道上会陷入挣扎，但他对进入排位赛一直持乐观态度。
“在第一圈或第二圈，我们的底板被什么东西撞了一下，一些碎片之类的，损坏了底板，我们因此损失了大量下压力，大约零点几秒，”汉密尔顿说。
随后他又因为电量部署不足损失了更多时间，赛车在他飞驰圈结束时电量偏低。
“我的最后一圈已经尽可能好了，但我前面没有车，”他说。“然后我们在最后阶段出现了部署不足，仅部署问题就让我损失了大约零点六秒。所以真是祸不单行，这就是那种倒霉的日子。”
最后一圈没有前车为他提供尾流，汉密尔顿未能提升自己的最后一圈成绩。尽管他觉得进入第三节排位赛是可能的，但汉密尔顿承认，要想在发车格上排得更高会非常困难。
“嗯，我们当时只是在勉强争取进入第三节排位赛，”他说。他认为如果没有部署损失、没有下压力损失，他本可以晋级，但他补充说“那仍然会很艰难”。
“但我的圈速足以让我排在那里，”汉密尔顿说。“事情就是这样。对整个车队来说，这绝对不是什么好日子，但我们会努力在明天向前迈进。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton reveals floor damage cost him in F1 Las Vegas qualifying
The Ferrari driver says debris damage and a loss of energy deployment cost him a place in Q3, as both Ferraris were knocked out in Q2
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton says floor damage and a lack of energy deployment cost him a place in Q3 in the Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying session.
The Ferrari driver qualified 12th, just 0.167 seconds away from making the top 10, one place behind team-mate Charles Leclerc. It was Ferrari's first double Q2 exit since Imola last year.

Hamilton, who is currently fighting for second in the drivers' championship, told Sky Sports F1 he had been optimistic going into qualifying, even though the Maranello outfit expected to struggle on Las Vegas's long straights.
"On the first or second lap, we took a hit on something on the floor, some debris or something, damaged the floor, we lost a bunch of downforce with it, a few tenths," Hamilton said.
He then lost more time to a lack of deployment, as the car ran low on electrical energy at the end of his lap.

"My lap was as good as it could be at the end, but I didn't have anyone ahead of me," he said. "And then we had a lack of deployment at the end, and I lost like six-tenths just on deployment. So when it rains, it pours, and that's one of those days."

With nobody ahead of him for a tow on his final run, Hamilton failed to improve on his last lap. While he felt a Q3 appearance was possible, Hamilton admitted it would have been difficult to qualify much higher up the grid.

"Well, we were scrapping to just get into Q3," he said. He believed he could have made it through "without the deployment loss, without the downforce loss", but added that "it would have still been tough".
"But my lap was good enough in order to put me there," Hamilton said. "It is what it is. It's definitely not a nice day for all the team, but we'll try and move forward tomorrow."
